claim: Sample cards and reviews use separate local storage and never change ordinary local data.
sandbox: Create an ordinary card, enter /demo, reset sample data, then start for real and assert only the ordinary card remains.

claim: Cards and reviews remain in browser storage after reload.
sandbox: Use /demo, add a card, reload, and assert the card and demo banner remain.

claim: Recall Calibrator is free to use without an account or payment.
where: Landing facts, Privacy page, Terms page
sandbox: Complete a review from /demo and assert no credential or payment UI is needed.

claim: A review sends no request outside the product origin.
sandbox: Record every browser request during a /demo review and assert every origin is the product origin.

claim: Exact matching ignores case, accents, whitespace, and punctuation.
sandbox: Use the /demo HTTP card with punctuation and whitespace changes, then assert Match.

claim: Required-keyword cards report partial recall when only some required keywords are present.
sandbox: Create a keyword card in /demo, type one of two keywords, and assert Partial.

claim: A card can accept multiple exact answers.
sandbox: Create a two-answer card in /demo, type the alternate answer, and assert Match.

claim: The typed-recall result stays sealed until a self-grade is chosen.
sandbox: Reveal a /demo answer, inspect the accessible review state before grading, then assert the result appears after grading.

claim: Insights report grade alignment and review history.
sandbox: Open /demo and assert the populated alignment report and all eight review rows.

claim: Insights report generous or harsh grade tendency and a recent grade-gap trend after eight reviews.
sandbox: Open /demo and assert the populated tendency and recent-trend output.

claim: Each result shows a deterministic suggested interval and the rule used.
sandbox: Create a 10-day /demo card, produce an exact match, and assert the 25-day result and 2.5× rule.
Download CSV from /demo and assert its header plus one row for each sample review.

claim: A JSON export restores cards and reviews.
sandbox: Export /demo JSON, delete the sample data, restore the file, and assert the sample cards return.

claim: Local cards and reviews can be deleted explicitly.
sandbox: Confirm deletion from /demo and assert every sample card is gone.

claim: The app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Use a new browser context, visit /demo until service-worker controlled, set it offline, reload, and assert the sample report returns.

claim: Recall Calibrator is an installable standalone PWA.
sandbox: Open /demo, assert service-worker control, then read the live manifest for standalone display and 192/512 icons.

claim: The review works by keyboard on a 390 px-wide screen.
sandbox: At 390 px, use only Tab and Enter from /demo through reveal and grade, then assert the result and no horizontal overflow.
Emulate reduced motion at /demo and assert the visual transform is removed and transitions are effectively instant.
